name: PocketBase

evidence.server: F02: self-hosted backend with auth collections, login and user administration; F05: self-hosted only

line: Self-hosted Go backend with accounts, login, and SQLite.

free.text: Free MIT server; you run it

cells.freeUsers: No vendor user cap; deployment resources limit use
cells.sso: OIDC included; no native SAML or SCIM product

mau.math: The PocketBase software licence costs $0. The server, backups, delivery and operations are separate costs.
